work.title: A closer look
work.intro: Selected projects. Different problems, the same attention to how things work.

library.title: Good systems start with clear boundaries.
library.description: A library catalog API that keeps HTTP, business rules and persistence separate. Built around the everyday work of managing books.
library.decision: Normalized ISBN validation, paginated reads and soft deletion, backed by domain tests.

android.title: Repetitive actions. Deliberate workflows.
android.description: A desktop workflow editor that controls an Android device through ADB. Visual recognition, branching and retries turn individual actions into reusable workflows.
android.decision: Device work runs off the GUI thread. Templates are cached per run, with cooperative stopping and a bounded execution log.

portfolio.title: The interface is part of the engineering.
portfolio.description: This portfolio brings together server-rendered content, three languages and a responsive design system. A small, considered home for my work.
portfolio.decision: Explicit project curation, cached GitHub enrichment and native CSS motion keep the experience resilient and lightweight.
